author: Ayjeydee
quote:
Well here we are. 13 years of waiting and anticipation brought us to this day where I am having to rate this game a 3/10. 
Let's start with the bad things because we already know what good things they've done.
• They removed GT from GTA. Can't still cars just anywhere now. I know. I'm not making it up.
• Multiple girlfriends? Forget about it. You have one girlfriend who cheats on you and you're going to love her no matter what. 
• Oh you'll hate this. Prostitutes are no longer a thing. I guess you can't cheat on your cheating girlfriend in any way or form.
• You have to be a good boy to get the good ending. Which means no unnecessary killing or carnage. Like that's exactly what we do in a GTA game lol- be a law abiding citizen.
• No more shoot outs are allowed in clubs.
• Protesting NPCs, especially the one of color are no longer killable.
• Planes pass through tall buildings on purpose.

Yeah this list can go on and on but you get why I rated it so poorly. GTA6 has the possibility to be a great game but until it releases on PC, this will remain a piece of media that pushes more agendas than you push buttons on the controller. But hey, have fun if you're having fun. 

Thanks
- IJD
